families.question: May the deployment proceed?
families.decisionRule: Return ALLOW only when constraintFact is exactly gate_enabled and observationFact is exactly health_green; otherwise return BLOCK.
families.constraintContext: The release policy requires its protected feature gate to be enabled.
families.observationContext: The current production health window is green.

families.question: May the schema-v3 producer rollout proceed?
families.decisionRule: Return ALLOW only when constraintFact is exactly consumer_v3_ready and observationFact is exactly producer_v3_staged; otherwise return BLOCK.
families.constraintContext: All required consumers must accept schema v3 before producer activation.
families.observationContext: The producer build is staged but not yet active.

families.question: May legacy protocol support be removed?
families.decisionRule: Return ALLOW only when constraintFact is exactly minimum_supported_2_4 and observationFact is exactly oldest_active_2_6; otherwise return BLOCK.
families.constraintContext: Removal is permitted when every active client is newer than the minimum supported line.
families.observationContext: The oldest active client cohort has already advanced beyond the minimum line.

families.question: May the risky optimization be enabled?
families.decisionRule: Return ALLOW only when constraintFact is exactly remaining_budget_12 and observationFact is exactly predicted_burn_7; otherwise return BLOCK.
families.constraintContext: The rollout must fit inside the remaining error budget.
families.observationContext: The forecasted burn is lower than the remaining budget.

families.question: May the primary database maintenance begin?
families.decisionRule: Return ALLOW only when constraintFact is exactly required_replicas_3 and observationFact is exactly healthy_replicas_3; otherwise return BLOCK.
families.constraintContext: Maintenance requires three healthy replicas before the primary is stopped.
families.observationContext: Only two replicas currently pass the full health check.
